rubric.role_summary: On-site Berlin CFO role leading financial architecture, capital structure, financing, M&A, controls, modeling, and the finance organization for a growing industrial-materials trading and distribution business.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
On-site Berlin CFO role leading financial architecture, capital structure, financing, M&A, controls, modeling, and the finance organization for a growing industrial-materials trading and distribution business.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Strong background in accounting firms, investment banking, or private equity.
- Hands-on company-building or scale-up experience.
- Experience with equity, debt, or M&A transactions.
- Accounting and financial controls expertise.
- Financial modeling skills.
- Professional background from Germany, France, or the UK.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Transaction services background within accounting firms.
- Private equity background in growth equity, infrastructure, or industrials.
- Experience in working-capital-intensive or transaction-heavy businesses.
- Hands-on company-building or scale-up experience with exposure to acquisitions.
- Proven track record across equity, debt, and M&A transactions.
- Ability to design and evolve capital structures.
- Deep understanding of accounting, controls, and risk frameworks.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Berlin area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
